description: NHGIS — census geography crosswalks via Portal: links schools (ncessch) and colleges (unitid) to census tracts, block groups, CBSAs, and regions (census-geography vintages 1990-2020; mirror file-year/linkage coverage 1980-2023). Portal provides geography linkage tables ONLY; browse census demographics in the public NHGIS Data Finder, then sign in with a free IPUMS NHGIS account to submit, manage, or download extracts. API extract requests also need an API key. Use for linking education or institutional data to census geography.
